---
title: "3 · Common rules"
---

Tiers, evidence flags and cuts of a ranking all place some units above others and leave some pairs unranked. We
compare their pairwise directions using the same posterior and loss. [Fixed quantile tiers](fixed-tiers.qmd)
show how group sizes determine disclosure. [Matched-disclosure comparisons](rule-comparison.qmd) then ask how
many errors a rule expects relative to reports that state as many pairs. Other examples examine [stability under
repeated measurement](stability.qmd) and the additional choices needed for [allocation and
classification](one-place.qmd).
